name: kimi-voiceover-video
description: Turn a voice recording into a fully animated, captioned, sound-designed short video. Built for Kimi Code CLI with a customizable brand that defaults to Kimi violet.
author: Dancan254

interface.shortDescription: Voice note in, animated vertical Short out
interface.longDescription: Drop in a voice note or to-camera take and get a polished 1080x1920 Short: local word-level transcription, kinetic typography, camera moves, images, synthesized sound design and a voice-ducked music bed. The agent guides brand setup on first run and asks before the expensive render steps.
